title: Trilegal, DSK Legal act on Laser Power & Infra ₹742 crore IPO
description: Laser Power & Infra Limited has made an initial public offering of equity shares aggregating to ₹742 crore, comprising a fresh issue aggregating to ₹542 crore and offer for sale of 9,345,793 equity shares by Deepak Goel, Rakhi Goel and Devesh Goel (Promoter Selling Shareholders) aggregating to ₹200 crore.Trilegal advised Laser Power & Infra and the Promoter Selling Shareholders on this IPOThe transaction was led by Abhinav Maker (Partner), with support from Ajo Jomy (Counsel) and Associa
